reference.citation: Dunn OJ (1964) multiple comparisons using rank sums. Reference impls: PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest and scikit_posthocs.posthoc_dunn. Data: vertical-GRF push-off peak (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) across five gait classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes all pairwise Dunn comparisons (Bonferroni) of the vertical-GRF push-off peak across the five gait classes with PMCMRplus and scikit_posthocs and confirms dunnTest reproduces both to machine precision; also reports the healthy-vs-pathology / pathology-pathology significance split
